I am so tired. I wake up at half past five on Mondays.
Half past five? Why?
Music class before school. My mother drives me. She wakes up at five, poor thing.
That is dedication. I get bored if I wake up before seven.
And what do you do after school?
Nothing, honestly. I scroll on my phone and I chat with my cousins.
Every day?
Not on Tuesdays. On Tuesdays I hang out with them at the park.
So you spend all your free time on the same three people.
I am hooked on them. What can I say?

Hey, it is Sam. You asked about my week, so here it is. I wake up at half past six, which is too early. School finishes at one, and after that I usually go home and sleep for twenty minutes. Do not judge me. On Tuesdays I play basketball, and on Thursdays I hang out with my cousins at the mall. At night I scroll on my phone for way too long. My mother says I spend three hours a day on it. She is probably right. What does your week look like?

Good afternoon. This is the school radio, and today we have the results of our survey. We asked two hundred students one question: what do you do after school? Here is what they said. Forty percent go straight home and watch something. Twenty-five percent hang out with friends. Twenty percent do sport. And fifteen percent said they do their homework first. Only fifteen percent! One student wrote, and I quote, I get bored in five minutes. Well. Same. That is all for today.
